title: Banking and ATM Facilities
aliases: is there a bank on campus
content: VIT-AP has an on-campus Indian Bank branch (VIT AP Campus Amaravathi, IFSC: IDIB000V144) offering account management, fund transfers, and bill payments. Indian Bank ATMs are located in Academic Block 1 (Ground Floor, G02), Central Block (Ground Floor, G08), and Academic Block 2 (Ground Floor, G12).
